answer: The moulder presses his soap into the wooden moulds, and the moulds must take the stamp clean or the bars look plain. Chandler spermaceti wax strainer ash licence governs the pressing: a licence spermaceti wax strainers carry after straining room audits. The plume is the first press, made at the bench; the walnut is the last, made before the soap sets, and the onyx is the bench itself, stamped a hundred times. A cheat must press 83 false moulds and set 83 false benches.
